properties.name: ADBE Text Expressible Amount
properties.expression: // Type Array v2.0 - Animates type with a user-defined interpolation and per-index offset. Add Markers for control over individual indexes.try {	E = effect(thisProperty.propertyGroup(1).name.split('<')[1].split('>')[0] ); // Rename <Type Array> in the selector name to target a different effect.} catch(e) {	E = effect("Type Array"); // Fall back to original "Type Array" effect;}i = textIndex;T = textTotal;if (E(5) == true) { i = T+1-i; }delay = (i-1)*framesToTime(E(2));n = marker.numKeys;if (E(4) == true && n > 0) {  // If Use Markers is on...	if (E(1).numKeys > 0 ) {		start = E(1).key(1).time; // Set start to the first keyframe.	} else {		start = 0;	}	if (i <= n) {		delay = marker.key(i).time - start;  // If this text index has a marker, set delay using the marker's time.	} else {		delay = marker.key(n).time - start + (i-n)*framesToTime(E(2)); // If we're out of markers, set delay using last marker.	}}t = time - framesToTime(E(3)) - delay;  // Sets sample time to current time, less the amount of shift and computed delay for this text index.result = E(1).valueAtTime(t)*value/100;

transform.expression: const targetLayer = thisComp.layer("AIR WHOSE");const progress = thisLayer.effect("Pseudo/ADBE Trace Path")("Pseudo/ADBE Trace Path-0001")/100;const targetProp = targetLayer("ADBE Root Vectors Group")(1)("ADBE Vectors Group")(1)("ADBE Vector Shape");function fromShapeGroup(inputXY, shapeGroup) {	const transformedXY = inputXY - shapeGroup.transform.anchorPoint;	const angleRadians = degreesToRadians(shapeGroup.transform.rotation);	const rotatedX = transformedXY[0] * Math.cos(angleRadians) - transformedXY[1] * Math.sin(angleRadians);	const rotatedY = transformedXY[0] * Math.sin(angleRadians) + transformedXY[1] * Math.cos(angleRadians);	const scaledX = rotatedX * (shapeGroup.transform.scale[0] / 100);	const scaledY = rotatedY * (shapeGroup.transform.scale[1] / 100);	const newPosXY = [scaledX, scaledY] + shapeGroup.transform.position;	return newPosXY;}let targetValue = targetProp.pointOnPath(progress)let containerGroup = targetProp.propertyGroup(3);let limit = 40; // In case of infinite loopwhile (--limit && !(containerGroup instanceof Layer)) {	if (containerGroup.transform && containerGroup.transform.position) {		targetValue = fromShapeGroup(targetValue, containerGroup);	}	containerGroup = containerGroup.propertyGroup(1);}targetLayer.toWorld(targetValue);

properties.name: ADBE Vector Shape
properties.expression: var nullLayerNames = ["Shape Layer 2: Path 1 [1.1.0]","Shape Layer 2: Path 1 [1.1.1]","Shape Layer 2: Path 1 [1.1.2]"];var origPath = thisProperty;var origPoints = origPath.points();var origInTang = origPath.inTangents();var origOutTang = origPath.outTangents();var getNullLayers = [];function toShapeGroup(inputXY, shapeGroup) {	const transformedXY = inputXY - shapeGroup.transform.position;	const scaledX = transformedXY[0] / (shapeGroup.transform.scale[0] / 100);	const scaledY = transformedXY[1] / (shapeGroup.transform.scale[1] / 100);	const angleRadians = -degreesToRadians(shapeGroup.transform.rotation);	const rotatedX = scaledX * Math.cos(angleRadians) - scaledY * Math.sin(angleRadians);	const rotatedY = scaledX * Math.sin(angleRadians) + scaledY * Math.cos(angleRadians);	const newPosXY = [rotatedX, rotatedY] + shapeGroup.transform.anchorPoint;	return newPosXY;}for (var i = 0, il = nullLayerNames.length; i < il; i++){	try{		getNullLayers.push(effect(nullLayerNames[i])("ADBE Layer Control-0001"));	} catch(err) {		getNullLayers.push(null);	}}for (var i = 0, il = getNullLayers.length; i < il; i++){	if (getNullLayers[i] != null && getNullLayers[i].index != thisLayer.index){		let targetValue = fromCompToSurface(getNullLayers[i].toComp(getNullLayers[i].anchorPoint));		let containerGroup = thisProperty.propertyGroup(3);		let limit = 40; // In case of infinite loop	const transformGroups = [];		while (--limit && !(containerGroup instanceof Layer)) {			if (containerGroup.transform && containerGroup.transform.position) {				transformGroups.unshift(containerGroup);			}		containerGroup = containerGroup.propertyGroup(1);		}		transformGroups.forEach(g => targetValue = toShapeGroup(targetValue, g));		origPoints[i] = targetValue;}}createPath(origPoints,origInTang,origOutTang,origPath.isClosed());
